# Colecto v0.8.0 — beta

Colecto has graduated from alpha to **beta**. From this release on, updates carry your
data forward instead of starting over, settings follow improved defaults unless you
changed them, and the desktop app no longer opens a network port.

## What beta means

- **Your data moves with you.** Colecto's database now has a versioned format. When an
  update changes it, Colecto copies the old file aside (`colecto.db.before-v<N>`) and
  migrates it on startup. Going back to an older version is not supported: an older
  Colecto refuses a database a newer one wrote. See
  [Storage](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.8.0/docs/storage.md).
- **Better defaults reach you.** Settings now store only what you changed. When a
  release improves a default, everyone who never changed that setting gets the new one.
- **A stable extension API.** Extensions target API 1, which stays supported; later
  changes add API 2, 3 and so on. See
  [API versions](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.8.0/docs/extensions/api-versions/README.md).

## Breaking changes

This is a clean break from the alpha. Nothing from alpha carries over.

- **Start fresh.** The app has a new identifier, `com.kogical.colecto`, so the desktop
  and Android apps keep their data in a new place and begin with onboarding. Add your
  accounts again. On Android, the beta installs next to the alpha app; uninstall the
  alpha yourself.
- **Daemon, Docker and `COLECTO_DATA_DIR` users:** the beta refuses an alpha
  `colecto.db` and says so at startup. Stop Colecto, move `colecto.db` out of the data
  directory (`~/.local/state/colecto`, `/data` in Docker, or your `COLECTO_DATA_DIR`),
  and start it again.
- **No accounts from environment variables.** `COLECTO_IMAP_*`, `COLECTO_SMTP_*`,
  `COLECTO_MAIL_*` and `COLECTO_JMAP_*` are no longer read. Add accounts in the app or
  through the HTTP API.
- **`colecto notify` is gone.** It only printed a pointer to `daemon` since v0.7.0. The
  app also no longer removes the old `colecto-notifications.service` unit; if you still
  have one from v0.6 or earlier, run
  `systemctl --user disable --now colecto-notifications.service` and delete it.
- **Notification preferences** no longer accept `mail`, `approvals` or `updates`; those
  live in the Notifications extension's settings since v0.7.0.

## Breaking API changes

### API 1

The extension API started over at 1 for beta, and the alpha's APIs are gone. The new
API 1 is the alpha's API 2, unchanged: an extension that declared `api_version = 2`
works again after changing it to `api_version = 1`. Packages built for the alpha's
API 1 that use `settings.section`, row context menus or the newer icons now load too.
Extensions you installed during the alpha are gone with the alpha's data; install them
again.

## Also in this release

- **No open port in the desktop app.** The interface and API now run inside the app
  itself (`colecto://`). A local port opens only while MCP is on, and then only for API
  keys. See
  [Architecture](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.8.0/docs/architecture.md#desktop-app-without-a-port).
- **Settings reset over the API.** `POST /api/v1/preferences` takes
  `reset: ["notifications.position", …]` to return settings to their defaults.
